lamps.steady: Seat belt is unfastened. Fasten your seat belt before driving.
lamps.flashing: Seat belt unfastened while driving above 20 km/h. Fasten seat belt immediately.

lamps.steady: Malfunction in SRS airbag or pretensioner system. Have vehicle inspected by authorised repairer.
Engine oil pressure is low. Turn off engine and check oil level; add oil if required.
Malfunction in Motor Driven Power Steering. Have vehicle inspected by authorised repairer.
Parking brake applied or brake fluid level low. Check brake fluid or release parking brake.
ABS and brake systems malfunction. Avoid high speed and abrupt braking; inspect vehicle.
Malfunction in ABS. Hydraulic brakes still work. Have vehicle inspected by authorised repairer.
Fuel tank is nearly empty. Refuel vehicle as soon as possible.
Malfunction in emission control system, engine, or powertrain. Inspect vehicle as soon as possible.
Malfunction in alternator or electrical charging system. Check drive belt and inspect vehicle.
One or more tyres are under-inflated. Stop and inflate tyres to proper pressure.
lamps.flashing: TPMS malfunction. Have vehicle inspected by authorised repairer as soon as possible.

lamps.steady: Malfunction with Electronic Parking Brake. Have vehicle inspected by authorised repairer.
White when standby, green when holding vehicle, yellow when malfunctioning. Inspect if yellow.
Malfunction in driver assistance or vehicle systems. Check cluster display to resolve.
Smart key detected in vehicle. If key present but undetected, inspect vehicle.
lamps.flashing: Smart key not in vehicle or immobiliser malfunction. Have vehicle inspected.

lamps.steady: Malfunction with LED headlight. Have vehicle inspected by authorised repairer.
lamps.flashing: Malfunction with LED headlight related part. Inspect vehicle as soon as possible.

lamps.steady: Malfunction with ESC system. Have vehicle inspected by authorised repairer.
ESC system is deactivated.
Forward Safety deselected, disabled, or malfunctioning. Inspect vehicle if light stays on.
lamps.flashing: Red when Forward Safety function is actively operating.

lamps.steady: Grey when inactive, green when ready, yellow when malfunctioning. Inspect if yellow.
lamps.flashing: Green when Lane Keeping Assist is operating.

lamps.steady: Driver Attention Warning disabled or malfunctioning. Inspect vehicle if light stays on.
lamps.flashing: Driver Attention Warning recommends taking a break.

lamps.steady: Green when operating, grey when conditions are not satisfied.
lamps.flashing: White when steering wheel assist is cancelled.

lamps.steady: High beam headlights are turned on or flashed.
Low beam headlights are turned on.
Position lights or headlights are turned on.
Speed limiter feature is enabled.
Cruise control system is enabled.
Turn signal system malfunction if light stays steady without blinking. Inspect vehicle.
White when ready, green when operating.
Door is open or not fully closed. Close door completely before driving.
Road surface may be icy. Avoid speeding, sudden acceleration, or sharp turning.
Vehicle detected in rear blind spot area.
lamps.flashing: Collision risk detected when turn signal is on toward detected vehicle.

lamps.steady: Soot accumulated in DPF. Drive above 60 km/h in 2nd gear or higher to clear.
lamps.flashing: DPF malfunction or self-regeneration required. Visit an authorised repairer.

lamps.steady: Urea solution level is low. Refill as soon as possible.
